Ready for the maintainer to merge.

- The note condition at `crates/motion/src/machining3d/hsm.rs:236` agrees with the entry condition at `crates/motion/src/machining3d/ladder.rs:195`.
- The new test checks both tool settings and confirms that the geometric air-entry flag stays true.
- The change only corrects a note. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or gouge and collision checks. No goldens changed. No UI files changed.
- The decision record explains the condition and the alternatives.

Local checks used a separate worktree with its own target directory. The trial merge with upstream/main at `983f527bd7aab4f856666e62f0c06f381bc57474` reported "Already up to date."

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-motion --no-run` | Passed |
| Motion library tests | 424 passed; 10 ignored; 0 failed |
| `pocket3d_hsm` | 3 passed; 1 ignored; 0 failed |
| `rotary_adaptive` | 3 passed; 3 ignored; 0 failed |
| `center_cut_law` | 6 passed; 0 failed |
| Separate run of `air_entry_note_matches_center_cutting_tool` | 1 passed; 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

The ignored tests were not run. They belong to the existing heavy or diagnostic test sets. The gate plan was read with `--dry-run`; the full quick gate was not run. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge: none.

Mutations: none run. This change only corrects a diagnostic note and does not need a safety-tier review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge train (main `983f527bd` + #2420, #2450, #2459, #2461, #2477, batch tier on Linux): this PR breaks a law test that came in with #2420.

With main `7bcc13a4b` (which now has #2420) merged into this head, `cargo test -p camcraft-cl --test origin_approach` fails `no_generator_seeds_the_clearance_plane_without_the_approach_law`. Main alone passes it, and main + #2459 passes it.

Fix: merge main into this branch and route the new air-entry path through #2420's approach law (do not relax the law test). Back to draft; `merge-ready` swapped for `needs-rework` until a new head is reviewed.

Merged upstream/main. Fixed the air-entry test fixture to use PathBuilder::approached at its clearance-plane seed. Production entry logic is unchanged.

The unchanged no_generator_seeds_the_clearance_plane_without_the_approach_law test pins the review finding. Extended air_entry_note_matches_center_cutting_tool to check the opening rapid at clearance and path chaining. Reverting the builder fix makes both pins fail. Restoring it makes both pass. All seven origin_approach tests pass.

Quick gate: 35 steps passed, zero failed. Motion clippy with all targets and -D warnings passed.

New head: 6d2bd7da50e9442c259ab004cd940caf735b8b37.

Please re-review this head.
